rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a fair/good blastocyst with decent ICM and weaker, looser TE, and appropriately notes the 3 vs 4 expansion ambiguity. Minor limitation is some speculative detail (possible collapse, exact quadrant, cytoplasmic haze) from a single static image.

Strong integration of maternal age, AMH/ovarian response, tubal factor diagnosis, endometrial thickness, BMI/lifestyle, sperm parameters, and possible day-4 kinetics with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logical and well-structured, with the implantation estimate reasonably tied to morphology and age-related aneuploidy risk. Minor issue is the unresolved day-4 blastocyst inconsistency and some cautious speculation around grading.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading principles and standard IVF practice: acknowledges grading terminology, supports single embryo transfer, avoids over-calling one failed transfer, and gives balanced PGT-A counseling. Slight deviation is entertaining a day-4 blastocyst interpretation without stronger caution.

Provides clear practical recommendations for proceeding with transfer, SET, luteal support considerations, when not to over-investigate, future ICSI/PGT-A discussion, embryo banking, and preconception optimization.
